changeSet.author: codbi
changeSet.comment: Create table storing the change log of every CodBi AI assistant inference. Each successful Run of the form assistant records one row holding the timestamp, the form key, the user's prompt, the classified intent, the used model, and a structured JSON description of the changes applied to the form and/or the workflow.

changeSet.author: codbi
changeSet.comment: Add token count column so the change log can display the tokens used per inference.

changeSet.author: codbi
changeSet.comment: Add separate input/output token count columns so the change log can display the tokens used per inference split into input (prompt) and output (completion).

changeSet.author: codbi
changeSet.comment: Add the estimated cost (computed from input/output tokens and the configured price per 1M tokens) and its currency so the change log can display the price per inference.

changeSet.author: codbi
changeSet.comment: Add the login name of the user who ran the inference so the change log can show who triggered each entry.

changeSet.author: codbi
changeSet.comment: Add a clarification JSON column holding the clarifying questions the AI asked the user and the answers it received (each: question, answer, optional attached document name), so the change log can show the full dialogue behind a run.

changeSet.author: codbi
changeSet.comment: Create table storing which user checked/dismissed a sensitive element occurrence in the change log (so a checked sensitive entry stays unmarked for that user and the check is attributable). One row per (log entry, element name, user).

changeSet.author: codbi
changeSet.comment: Widen the prompt column so the change log can store a chat turn together with the chat history it refers to (numbered options the user picks may be several turns back) instead of truncating it at 1000 characters — otherwise the referenced options could be cut off.

changeSet.author: codbi
changeSet.comment: Add a chat_reply column holding the AI's answer to a chat question. When a run is a pure chat turn (no form/workflow change) it is recorded as its own log entry with the user's question in `prompt` and the assistant's reply here, so the change log shows every chat message and its reply with the same tokens/cost columns as the other entries. The reply is stored as JSON {"text":"...","matomoStats":{...}} so the change log can render it as Markdown (and charts from the attached statistics) exactly like the chat reply buttons.

changeSet.author: codbi
changeSet.comment: Add a trips CLOB holding one entry per AI inference of the run (phase, model, input and output tokens, cost, currency) so the change log can break a run's total token usage and cost down per call instead of showing only the run sum.

changeSet.author: codbi
changeSet.comment: Add an items CLOB holding the FULL resolved form items / workflow node specs each run created or changed (with the container they live in), plus applied_from marking a row that was re-applied from an earlier entry WITHOUT an inference. The existing form_changes / workflow_changes columns only hold summaries (names + changed attributes), which cannot rebuild an element — the items column is what allows the change log's "repeat onto form" action to re-apply an entry to the CURRENT form deterministically (duplicate ids/names receive a _cb_ressurected_N suffix). Old rows have NULL and need the AI re-run instead.
